$comment: Accepted-risk register for the npm audit / OSV gate (scripts/audit-gate.mjs).
An entry here means: the advisory is real, we have assessed it against how
this application actually uses the dependency, and we are choosing not to
block builds on it. Every entry needs a concrete reason and a review date.
Adding an entry is a security decision — it should be reviewed like one.
Kept deliberately in sync with terraform-registry-frontend's register: both
frontends carry the same react-router dependency via the shared suite-ui.
